helperInvocation.descriptors: Existing little-endian framed stdin0, result3, guardian-stop4; caller owns frame input and stop pipe. Run within existing approved namespace; no sandbox-disabling flags.

physicalPrintSemantics.beforeAuthorization: Abort serializes with state lock and prevents send.
physicalPrintSemantics.afterAuthorization: No cancellation claim; wait <=30 seconds for terminal submission result. Failure/timeout is explicit unavailable + unknown queue status; no retry.
physicalPrintSemantics.success: Existing printed result means spooler accepted the job, not physical page completion. Late abort does not overwrite this outcome.
physicalPrintSemantics.cleanupFailureAfterSuccess: Preserve success, report stderr and retain private stage.
physicalPrintSemantics.currentlySupportedSettings: A4/Letter; portrait/landscape; all pages, one copy, 1-up, 100% scale, normal order. Unsupported options rejected before submission.
